name: @pipeworx/mcp-mixpanel

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Query event data from Mixpanel for a date range. Returns event counts and properties. Example: get_events({ from_date: "2024-01-01", to_date: "2024-01-31", event: "Sign Up", _apiKey: "your_api_secret" })

from_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

to_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

event.description: Optional specific event name to filter by, e.g. "Sign Up", "Purchase"

_apiKey.description: Mixpanel API secret (used for Basic auth)

tools.name: get_funnels
tools.description: Get funnel conversion data from Mixpanel. Shows step-by-step conversion rates. Example: get_funnels({ funnel_id: "12345", from_date: "2024-01-01", to_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "your_api_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Mixpanel API secret (used for Basic auth)

tools.name: get_retention
tools.description: Get user retention cohort data from Mixpanel. Shows how many users return over time. Example: get_retention({ from_date: "2024-01-01", to_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "your_api_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Mixpanel API secret (used for Basic auth)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mixpanel forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mixpanel pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
